title: Efficient tool-use anti-pattern catalog
description: Validates schemas/efficient-tool-use/anti-patterns.yaml — the canonical list of shell-toolbox anti-patterns. Consumed by any future scanner script that wants to grep staged scripts for these patterns as a pre-commit check.

id.description: Kebab-case stable id. Used in commit messages + scanner output.

tool.description: Primary tool the pattern abuses. `shell-general` for cross-tool patterns (useless cat, etc.).

bad_pattern.description: Verbatim bad form. Use shell-quoted text; consumers may use this as a literal grep needle.

why_bad.description: One-line explanation of the failure mode (speed / correctness / safety).

replacement.description: Verbatim correct form. The 1:1 replacement an author should reach for instead.

severity.description: error = correctness / safety bug (silent corruption, broken on spaces, etc.). warn = perf / readability. info = stylistic.

detect.description: Optional regex (POSIX ERE) that a scanner can grep staged shell scripts for. Leave empty when the pattern is too context-dependent to mechanically detect.

references.description: Optional links to relevant docs / man pages / SKILL.md sections.
